about: The most `gh` call sites each file outside `plugins/github/` may hold: NONE (A11-160, step 9). `files` is empty, and it stays empty: no file outside `plugins/github/` spawns `gh`, holds a `gh` argument list or reads GitHub's answer, so a call to GitHub goes into `plugins/github/`, behind the codeHost contract (`src/plugins/contracts/code-host.ts`) as a named operation of its `rows`. The scan reads `src/`, `scripts/` and `plugins/`, and every shell script of `host/`, `src/` and `plugins/` (a shell script's `spawns` is the number of times it runs `gh` as a command word). src/packaging/gh-call-ratchet.test.ts refuses any file outside the plugin with a spawn or a call shape, by name; there is no entry to raise. Only `phases` is a count that goes down.

org-health.about: The `gh` spawns of one org-health pass on the org-health fixture with a stub gh (agent-org#1225, src/packaging/tick-budget.test.ts). It only goes DOWN: lower it by hand when the phase sheds a read. A rise is refused by that test.
